title: Ask
body: Post in your website channel like you'd brief a person. Links, photos, PDFs and screenshots all work.

title: Draft
body: Sheepdog makes the change on a private copy of the site. The live site isn't touched.

title: Check
body: Links, speed, accessibility, spelling, the phone layout and a before and after comparison, on every change.

title: Preview
body: A preview link and screenshots arrive in the thread, usually within a few minutes.

title: Approve
body: Press the button and it's live in under a minute. Undo stays on the message for seven days.
